Good morning! **Mehdi** here. So I watched 'The Odyssey,' and it was fun and
deep and long but what stood out to me most was… the [frickin' creepy horror-
film trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bEpTgowZ1dI) masquerading as a
family ice-cream ad that they aired before the movie began.

In today's '**First Draft** ,' Elon Musk says outrageous things about Muslims
in a mainstream media interview and… no one seems to care. The Trump
administration backed down in its latest fight against the press, while the
president has issued sweeping new tariffs that nobody wants.

# 'Are You Anti-Muslim?'

There are many words that could be used to describe Elon Musk, the world's
first trillionaire and one of Donald Trump's biggest financial backers.

[Authoritarian](https://www.cnn.com/2025/02/18/media/elon-musk-60-minutes-
prison). [Narcissist](https://futurism.com/elon-musk-friend-power-narcissism).
[Hypocrite](https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2024/jan/15/elon-musk-
hypocrite-free-speech).
[Sadist](https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1886307316804263979?lang=en).
[Snowflake](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/nation/journalists-who-wrote-about-
owner-elon-musk-suspended-from-twitter).
[Racist](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/feb/12/elon-musk-posts-
january-white-supremacists).

But there is one label that somehow still escapes him, despite years of
evidence for it staring us in the face: _Islamophobe_.

That omission is remarkable. Musk has spent years amplifying some of the most
virulent anti-Muslim voices in the English-speaking world. He has
[funded](https://www.politico.eu/article/elon-musk-fund-uk-far-right-
ringleader-tommy-robinson-legal-fight/) and
[amplified](https://counterhate.com/research/the-owner-amplifier/) Britain's
most notorious anti-Muslim thug, [Tommy
Robinson](https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/tommy-robinson-elon-musk-want-
freed-jail-rcna186084). In early 2025, he was **" boosting disinformation and
divisive rhetoric on X about Muslim grooming gangs in the UK, posting almost
200 times,"** according to
_[Wired](https://archive.ph/UKXeo#selection-781.207-781.323)_ , in the space
of a few days. In recent weeks, he has been [praising and
promoting](https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2026/jun/30/elon-musk-
citizen-vigilante-immigration) the unabashedly anti-Muslim, anti-migrant film
'Citizen Vigilante.'

And yet, for all the justified scrutiny on Musk's politics, his businesses,
and his support for far-right parties, his Islamophobia has rarely been
treated as the scandal it plainly is. That says as much about our mainstream
media as it does about Elon Musk himself.

Credit, then, to Zanny Minton Beddoes, editor-in-chief of the _Economist_ ,
who managed to secure a [sit-down
interview](https://www.economist.com/insider/the-insider/an-interview-with-
elon-musk?ref=featured) with the world's first trillionaire and not only
raised his boosting of 'Citizen Vigilante' (**" it glorified the murdering of
a Muslim immigrant family, I honestly think that it is irresponsible for you
to put that up on X"**) but also asked him, rather bluntly: **" Are you anti-
Muslim?"**
